name: Events Grid
author: K.Paradorn
description: Dynamic event management and responsive event grid shortcode for Elementor and WordPress.

sections.description:
Events Grid replaces hardcoded HTML event cards with dynamic event posts managed from the WordPress admin area.

  • Custom post type for events
  • Event Categories taxonomy for filtering
  • Meta boxes for dates, venue, booth number, speaker badge, and URL
  • Responsive CSS Grid layout
  • Shortcode support for Elementor shortcode widget
  • Upcoming and past event sections with optional headings
  • Output caching for improved performance
  • Full REST API support
  • Settings page with configurable past-event fade-out period
sections.changelog:
1.2.4

  • Fix: bust_cache() now calls nitropack_sdk_purge_all() when NitroPack is active, so NitroPack's device-specific full-page HTML cache (desktop/tablet/mobile) is cleared whenever an event is added, edited, or deleted — preventing desktop browsers from serving stale output that required a manual NitroPack purge to resolve.

1.2.3

  • Fix: Reverted stylesheet registration to wp_register_style() so the CSS is only enqueued when the shortcode renders, preventing a critical error caused by the previous wp_enqueue_style() change.
  • Fix: Shortcode now injects an inline <link> stylesheet tag when wp_head has already fired and the CSS has not been output, covering AJAX and deferred-render contexts such as NitroPack lazy-load.

1.2.2

  • Fix: Shortcode cache key now includes the current date so past events are correctly excluded from the upcoming section after midnight without requiring a manual content save.

1.2.1

  • Fix: Shortcode cache key now includes the current date so past events are correctly excluded from the upcoming section after midnight without requiring a manual content save.

1.2.0

  • Security: CSV upload now validates actual file content (not just extension) to catch renamed binaries.
  • Security: Added 5 MB file size limit on CSV imports.
  • Security: Auto-updater verifies SHA-256 checksum when the update server provides one.
  • Security: Added 2,000-row hard cap on CSV imports to prevent memory exhaustion.
  • Performance: CSV duplicate detection uses a single pre-loaded hash set instead of one WP_Query per row.
  • Performance: CSV bulk import suspends cache invalidation during insert and flushes once at the end.
  • Performance: show_past="merged" now uses a single database query instead of two.
  • New: "Load Roboto from Google Fonts" toggle added under Events > Settings.

1.1.2

  • Added Events > Settings page with a "Hide past events after N days" option (0 = show all past events).

1.1.1

  • Added Modified By column to the Events admin list table showing which user last edited each event.

1.1.0

  • Added Event Categories taxonomy — filter events by category in the shortcode using category attribute.
  • Added upcoming_label and past_label shortcode attributes for section headings.
  • Fixed N+1 database query — all event meta now loaded in a single query per grid.
  • Added shortcode output caching (1-hour transient, auto-invalidated on save/delete).
  • Added Start Date, End Date, Venue, and Country columns to the Events admin list table.
  • Registered all meta fields with the REST API.
  • Moved Google Fonts from CSS @import to WordPress asset pipeline.
  • Removed CSS !important declarations in favour of scoped selectors.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
